recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, multi-character ensemble scene set on a concert stage with intense warm backlighting. Cartoon characters in streetwear and rave attire are grouped around a DJ turntable in the foreground, while a massive, multi-layered futuristic logo dominates the upper third of the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Characters radiating outward from a central DJ focal point
Warm orange stage lights contrasting with cool blue character outfits
Heavy metallic typography floating above the character group
Curved DJ console in the foreground creating a sense of depth
coreInvariants: Intense lens flare and bloom effects on background lights
Thick, clean black outlines on all character art
Metallic chrome gradients on all primary text elements
Vibrant, saturated color palette dominated by orange, blue, and yellow

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of 7-8 small-scale characters occupies the lower two-thirds, with a large-scale logo centered at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central character wearing headphones and a backwards cap, positioned directly behind the turntable.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular movement starting from the turntable, moving up through the characters' expressive poses, and culminating in the large title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with characters, stage equipment, and light effects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm orange and yellow stage lighting in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blue and cyan used for clothing and logo outlines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright pink, lime green, and chrome silver for accessories.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with extreme value contrast between bright light sources and dark character outlines.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended, geometric sans-serif with rounded corners.
letterConstructionRules: Double-stroke outlines with a thick blue outer border
Blocky, wide proportions reminiscent of early 2000s tech logos
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters 'D' and 'R' featuring exaggerated horizontal stretching

composition.relationshipToImage: floating in front of background lights

treatment.outline: thick blue with inner white glow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking variations of the same geometric weight to create a unified block of text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, square-geometric base skeleton of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vibrant concert stage background with warm orange floodlights, lens flares, and a group of animated animal characters in 90s streetwear (beanies, headphones, oversized jerseys) gathered around a DJ deck.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a custom vector logo in the top center using a wide, blocky, chrome-textured font with thick blue outlines and horizontal grooves.

verificationChecks: Is the text metallic and beveled?
Does the background feature intense orange light bloom?
Are characters outlined in thick black ink?
Is the composition centered and symmetrical?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the background lens flares
Thickness of the blue logo border
Curvature of the foreground DJ booth
mustRedesign: Specific character identities must be replaced with generic animal mascots
Original brand logos must be replaced with the described custom typography
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is garbled or nonsensical
Check that the chrome gradient is consistent across all letters
Verify that the orange lighting doesn't wash out the character details
Confirm the DJ turntable is the central foreground element
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Concert Stage Background] + [Streetwear Animal Mascots] + [Metallic Techno Typography] + [Orange/Blue Complementary Palette].
